scope: Actual unchanged picoarch/FrogUI on Linux7 with child-only libretro observer; diagnostic, not visual UI acceptance
conclusion: In this instrumented trial the frontend continued calling retro_run and the core returned, but issued only one video callback. Frontend-loop blockage does not explain the single-frame observation here. The first callback was nonempty and submitted to DRM; physical visibility was not tested.
limitations: Observer may affect timing; logged run count is not a performance measurement or proven uninstrumented behavior
Missing framebuffer device errors remain, but their sole causal role is not established
No visual, navigation, audible, game or full power-cycle acceptance
next: Inspect actual FrogUI retro_run draw conditions, initialization/worker state and legacy framebuffer dependency before preparing a new distinct experiment; do not repeat unchanged trials
